jica_manual_ref: Inspired by JICA SHEP PLUS — Maize production guide (Kenya)

varieties.name: H6213
varieties.supplier_notes: Highland hybrid; the most-planted certified maize in Kenya.

varieties.name: Katumani
varieties.supplier_notes: Dryland OPV; re-plantable from own seed — the choice where rains are unreliable.

timeline_template.description_en: Plough early so the first rain finds you ready. Incorporate manure or crop residue.
timeline_template.description_sw: Lima mapema ili mvua ya kwanza ikupate tayari. Weka samadi au mabaki ya mazao.

timeline_template.description_en: Plant at first good rains: 1 seed per hill, 10 kg per acre at 75cm × 30cm.
timeline_template.description_sw: Panda kwa mvua za kwanza: mbegu 1 kwa shimo, kilo 10 kwa eka kwa 75cm × 30cm.
timeline_template.tip_en: Match seed cost to rainfall reliability — hybrid where rains are dependable, OPV in dryland.
timeline_template.tip_sw: Linganisha gharama ya mbegu na uhakika wa mvua — hybrid mvua ya uhakika, OPV kanda kame.

timeline_template.description_en: Band 50 kg DAP per acre in the planting furrow — not on top.
timeline_template.description_sw: Weka kilo 50 za DAP kwenye mtaro wa kupanda — si juu.

timeline_template.description_en: First weeding — weeds compete hardest in the first six weeks.
timeline_template.description_sw: Palia kwanza — magugu hushindana zaidi wiki sita za kwanza.

timeline_template.description_en: Knee-high: top-dress 50 kg CAN per acre, 10 cm from the row. The single biggest yield lever.
timeline_template.description_sw: Mmea umefikia goti: weka kilo 50 za CAN, sentimita 10 kutoka mstari. Njia kuu ya mavuno.

timeline_template.description_en: Scout fall armyworm every 3-4 days — whorl damage is visible early, and early treatment saves the crop.
timeline_template.description_sw: Chunguza fall armyworm kila siku 3-4 — uharibifu wa kitovu unaonekana mapema.
timeline_template.tip_en: Late FAW detection costs 30-50% of yield.
timeline_template.tip_sw: Kuchelewa kugundua FAW kunapunguza mavuno kwa 30-50%.

timeline_template.description_en: Harvest when grain tests at or below 13.5% moisture — a fingernail stops denting the kernel.
timeline_template.description_sw: Vuna wakati nafaka ina unyevu 13.5% au chini — ukucha hauachi alama kwenye punje.
timeline_template.tip_en: Dry to 13.5%, shell, and store in hermetic bags — post-harvest losses run 20-30% in open bags.
timeline_template.tip_sw: Kausha hadi 13.5%, pukuchua, hifadhi kwa magunia maalum — hasara ni 20-30% kwa magunia wazi.

post_harvest.grading_criteria: Grade by moisture (13.5% max), cleanliness, and kernel size. Reject mouldy grain at shelling.
post_harvest.packaging_standard: 90 kg bags; hermetic bags for long storage, gunny bags only for immediate sale.
post_harvest.storage_tips_en: Dry to 13.5%, shell, hermetic bags. Hold 8-12 weeks and sell into the lean months.
post_harvest.storage_tips_sw: Kausha hadi 13.5%, pukuchua, magunia maalum. Subiri wiki 8-12 uuze miezi ya uhaba.

diseases.severity_classes: Low (window-pane whorl feeding) · High (ragged whorl, dead heart)
diseases.symptoms_en: Fresh frass in the whorl, transparent leaf windows, larvae with 4 dark spots on the 8th segment.
diseases.symptoms_sw: Kinyesi kipya kwenye kitovu, madirisha ya majani, viluwiluwi vyenye madoa 4 meusi.
diseases.treatment_en: Registered larvicide classes at label rates at first sign; hand-crush in small plots. Advisory: use PCPB-registered products only, at label rates.
diseases.treatment_sw: Dawa zilizoidhinishwa mara inapoonekana; pondaponda kwa mkono mashamba madogo. Shauri: tumia dawa zilizoidhinishwa na PCPB tu, kwa kiwango kilichoandikwa.
diseases.prevention_en: Scout whorls week 4-8; early planting; push-pull with Desmodium.
diseases.prevention_sw: Chunguza vitovu wiki 4-8; panda mapema; push-pull na Desmodium.
diseases.scanner_notes: Photograph the whorl open, not the whole plant; frass separates FAW from stalk borer.

diseases.symptoms_en: Entry holes with sawdust frass, wilting dead heart in young plants.
diseases.symptoms_sw: Matundu yenye vumbi la shina, kuuawa kwa kilele cha mmea mchanga.
diseases.treatment_en: Registered systemic granule at planting; sprays only before tunnelling starts. Advisory: use PCPB-registered products only, at label rates.
diseases.treatment_sw: Dawa ya kikundi cha systemic wakati wa kupanda; nyunyuza kabla ya kutoboa. Shauri: tumia dawa zilizoidhinishwa na PCPB tu, kwa kiwango kilichoandikwa.
diseases.prevention_en: Cut and destroy stalks after harvest; rotate.
diseases.prevention_sw: Kata na teketeza mashina baada ya kuvuna; zungusha.
diseases.scanner_notes: Holes near stem base vs FAW in whorl — two photos (whorl + stem) beat one.

diseases.severity_classes: Low (scattered lesions) · High (lesions to ear leaf)
diseases.symptoms_en: Rectangular grey-brown lesions, veins limit spread, lower leaves first.
diseases.symptoms_sw: Madoa ya kijivu yenye pembe, mishipa inazuia kuenea, majani ya chini kwanza.
diseases.treatment_en: Registered triazole/strobilurin classes at early onset. Advisory: use PCPB-registered products only, at label rates.
diseases.treatment_sw: Dawa za triazole/strobilurin zilizoidhinishwa mapema. Shauri: tumia dawa zilizoidhinishwa na PCPB tu, kwa kiwango kilichoandikwa.
diseases.scanner_notes: Rectangular-not-round is the key discriminator vs rust.

diseases.symptoms_en: Chlorotic mottling, yellowing from leaf tip, stunted cobs, early death.
diseases.symptoms_sw: Madoa ya manjano, kuwitikia kuanzia ncha, mishuke midogo, kifo mapema.
diseases.treatment_en: None — rogue and destroy; MLN-tolerant hybrids where available. Advisory: use PCPB-registered products only, at label rates.
diseases.treatment_sw: Hakuna tiba — ng'oa na uteketeze; hybrid sugu za MLN zilizopo. Shauri: tumia dawa zilizoidhinishwa na PCPB tu, kwa kiwango kilichoandikwa.
diseases.prevention_en: Certified seed, control vectors, report to KEPHIS.
diseases.prevention_sw: Mbegu zilizothibitishwa, dhibiti wadudu, ripoti KEPHIS.
diseases.scanner_notes: No-cure message must be explicit in UI; escalate to extension.

diseases.symptoms_en: Pale yellow streaks along veins, stunted growth, small cobs.
diseases.symptoms_sw: Michirizi ya manjano kwenye mishipa, kudhoofika, mishuke midogo.
diseases.treatment_en: None — leafhopper vector control early only. Advisory: use PCPB-registered products only, at label rates.
diseases.treatment_sw: Hakuna tiba — dhibiti wadudu wabebaji mapema tu. Shauri: tumia dawa zilizoidhinishwa na PCPB tu, kwa kiwango kilichoandikwa.
diseases.prevention_sw: Aina sugu, panda mapema kwa pamoja.
diseases.scanner_notes: Streaks follow veins — discriminator vs nutrient deficiency (interveinal).

market_notes.sell_windows_en: Prices bottom at harvest (Jun–Jul, Jan–Feb) and climb through the lean months (Sep–Nov, Mar–Apr). Hermetic storage lets you hold 8–12 weeks for 20–40% more per bag.
market_notes.sell_windows_sw: Bei hupungua wakati wa mavuno (Jun–Jul, Jan–Feb) na kupanda miezi ya uhaba (Sep–Nov, Mar–Apr). Hifadhi maalum inakuruhusu kusubiri wiki 8–12 kwa 20–40% zaidi kwa gunia.
market_notes.price_notes_en: 90 kg bag ~2,800–4,500 KES by season (November 2026). Planned acre: 25–40 bags; national average 8–12.
market_notes.price_notes_sw: Gunia la kilo 90 ~2,800–4,500 KES kwa msimu (Novemba 2026). Eka iliyopangwa: magunia 25–40; wastani wa kitaifa 8–12.
